在查看其他玩家时计算其物品品级。

attributes.Translated: 修复了 Chat2 在新颜色系统下崩溃的问题。调整功能在 Chat2 中仍无法使用，但不会再崩溃。

attributes.Original: Fixed colour display when in party.
attributes.Translated: 修复了组队时的颜色显示。

attributes.Original: Extended range of possible colours.
attributes.Translated: 扩展了可用颜色的范围。

attributes.Original: Added option to give all undefined characters the same colour.
attributes.Translated: 新增选项，可为所有未定义角色设置相同颜色。

attributes.Original: Added per channel configuration for colouring sender name and/or names in messages.
attributes.Translated: 新增按频道配置发送者名称和/或消息中名称的着色。

attributes.Original: Added option to reduce saturation of random names to improve readability.
attributes.Translated: 新增选项，可降低随机名称的饱和度以提升可读性。

attributes.Original: Chat Sounds Everywhere
attributes.Translated: 全频道聊天音效

attributes.Original: Enables <se.#> chat sounds everywhere, regardless of channel.
attributes.Translated: 在所有频道启用 <se.#> 聊天音效。

attributes.Original: Clickable Links in Chat
attributes.Translated: 聊天可点击链接

attributes.Original: Parses links posted in chat and allows them to be clicked.
attributes.Translated: 解析聊天中发布的链接并允许点击。

attributes.Original: Enable chat bubbles in combat
attributes.Translated: 战斗中启用聊天气泡

attributes.Original: Allow chat bubbles to be displayed while in combat.
attributes.Translated: 允许在战斗中显示聊天气泡。

attributes.Original: Custom Timestamp Format
attributes.Translated: 自定义时间戳格式

attributes.Original: Customize the timestamps displayed on chat messages.
attributes.Translated: 自定义聊天消息上显示的时间戳。

attributes.Original: Disable Auto Chat Inputs
attributes.Translated: 禁用自动聊天输入

attributes.Original: Prevent the game from inserting <flag> or other parameters into chat box.
attributes.Translated: 阻止游戏开始向聊天框插入 <flag> 或其他参数。

attributes.Original: Fixed game crash in 6.4
attributes.Translated: 修复了 6.4 版本的游戏开始崩溃问题

attributes.Original: Disable <item> when linking items.
attributes.Translated: 链接物品时禁用 <item>。

attributes.Original: Disable <status> when linking a status.
attributes.Translated: 链接状态时禁用 <status>。

attributes.Original: Disable <flag> when setting map flags.
attributes.Translated: 设置地图标记时禁用 <flag>。

attributes.Original: Disable <quest> when linking quests.
attributes.Translated: 链接任务时禁用 <quest>。

attributes.Original: Disable <pfinder> when linking party finder.
attributes.Translated: 链接招募时禁用 <pfinder>。

attributes.Original: Smart AutoScroll
attributes.Translated: 智能自动滚动

attributes.Original: Attempts to prevent autoscrolling when receiving new chat messages while scrolled up.
attributes.Translated: 在向上滚动时收到新聊天消息时尝试阻止自动滚动。

attributes.Original: Disable Chat Movement
attributes.Translated: 禁用聊天窗口移动

attributes.Original: Prevents movement of the chat window.
attributes.Translated: 阻止聊天窗口移动。

attributes.Original: Disable Novice Network Auto-Switch
attributes.Translated: 禁用新人频道自动切换

attributes.Original: Disables automatically selecting novice network when logging in or transferring to another server.
attributes.Translated: 登录或转移到其他服务器时禁用自动选择新人频道。

attributes.Original: Echo Party Finder
attributes.Translated: 超越之力招募

attributes.Original: Prints Party Finder description to chat when joining a group and entering a duty.
attributes.Translated: 加入队伍并进入任务时，将招募描述输出到聊天。

attributes.Original: Rewrote Tweak for Patch 6.5
attributes.Translated: 为 6.5 版本重写了调整功能

attributes.Original: Show PF description when joining party
attributes.Translated: 加入队伍时显示招募描述

attributes.Original: Show PF description when entering duty
attributes.Translated: 进入任务时显示招募描述

attributes.Original: Echo Story Selection
attributes.Translated: 超越之力剧情选择

attributes.Original: When given multiple choices during quests, print the selected option to chat.
attributes.Translated: 任务中出现多个选项时，将所选选项输出到聊天。

attributes.Original: Added option to hide some choices.
attributes.Translated: 新增选项，可隐藏部分选项。

attributes.Original: Display Character Name
attributes.Translated: 显示角色名称

attributes.Original: Display EXP Gain Percentage of Level
attributes.Translated: 显示经验获取占等级百分比

attributes.Original: Adds the percentage of your next level to exp gains in chat.
attributes.Translated: 在聊天中的经验获取后添加下一等级所需经验的百分比。

attributes.Original: Added support for Occult Crescent's phantom jobs.
attributes.Translated: 新增对神秘新月幻影职业的支持。

attributes.Original: Added support for earning experience on jobs other than current job.
attributes.Translated: 新增支持在当前职业以外的职业上获取经验。

attributes.Original: Fixed log message being hidden after Dalamud update.
attributes.Translated: 修复了 Dalamud 更新后日志消息被隐藏的问题。

attributes.Original: Hide Chat
attributes.Translated: 隐藏聊天

attributes.Original: Provides commands to hide the chat. (/$[CustomOrDefaultCommand] show|hide|toggle)
attributes.Translated: 提供隐藏聊天的命令。(/$[CustomOrDefaultCommand] show|hide|toggle)

attributes.Original: Hide Chat Automatically
attributes.Translated: 自动隐藏聊天

attributes.Original: Hides chat automatically except when typing.
attributes.Translated: 除输入时外自动隐藏聊天。

attributes.Original: Hide Chat Panel Buttons
attributes.Translated: 隐藏聊天面板按钮

attributes.Original: Hide the chat log name and close button on panels that have been split from the main window.
attributes.Translated: 隐藏从主窗口分离出的面板上的聊天记录名称和关闭按钮。

attributes.Original: Improved Chat Font Sizes
attributes.Translated: 改进聊天字体大小

attributes.Original: Allows you to change the font size for the chat windows beyond the default limits, and allows docked chat tabs to keep their font size separate from the main tab.
attributes.Translated: 允许你超出默认限制更改聊天窗口的字体大小，并允许停靠的聊天标签页保持与主标签页不同的字体大小。

attributes.Original: Improved Sent Message History
attributes.Translated: 改进已发送消息历史

attributes.Original: Recover messages after accidentally pressing up in the chat, and increase the amount of history retained.
attributes.Translated: 在聊天中误按上方向键后恢复消息，并增加保留的历史记录数量。

attributes.Original: Increase max line count in chat bubbles
attributes.Translated: 增加聊天气泡中的最大行数

attributes.Original: Allow upto 7 lines of text to be displayed in chat bubbles.
attributes.Translated: 允许聊天气泡中最多显示 7 行文本。

attributes.Original: Added ability to adjust the duration of chat bubbles.
attributes.Translated: 新增调整聊天气泡持续时间的功能。

attributes.Original: Max Lines
attributes.Translated: 最大行数

attributes.Original: Print Search Comment
attributes.Translated: 输出搜索留言

attributes.Original: Prints the Search Comment of people, that get inspected, into the chat.
attributes.Translated: 将被查看对象的搜索留言输出到聊天中。

attributes.Original: Rename Chat Tabs
attributes.Translated: 重命名聊天标签页

attributes.Original: Allows renaming the General and Battle tabs in the chat window.
attributes.Translated: 允许重命名聊天窗口中的综合和战斗标签页。

attributes.Original: Fixed issue causing tabs to become incorrectly sized.
attributes.Translated: 修复了导致标签页尺寸错误的问题。

attributes.Original: Fixed tabs not being named on login.
attributes.Translated: 修复了登录时标签页未命名的问题。

attributes.Original: Reply Channel Switch
attributes.Translated: 回复频道切换

attributes.Original: Allow typing /r to set active chat channel to Tell.
attributes.Translated: 允许输入 /r 将当前聊天频道设为悄悄话。

attributes.Original: Sticky Chat
attributes.Translated: 固定聊天频道

attributes.Original:
Sets the chat channel when you use temporary chat messages.
Example: "/p hello!" will set the chat channel to Party
attributes.Translated:
使用临时聊天消息时设置聊天频道。
例如："/p hello!" 会将聊天频道设为小队

attributes.Original: Sticky Shout Chat
attributes.Translated: 固定喊话聊天

attributes.Original: Prevents the game from automatically switching out of shout chat.
attributes.Translated: 阻止游戏自动退出喊话聊天。

attributes.Original: Zoomed Chat Customization
attributes.Translated: 放大聊天自定义

attributes.Original: Allows customization of the size and position of the zoomed chat view.
attributes.Translated: 允许自定义放大聊天视图的大小和位置。
